comparison.objective: Center a captive crossbar so its carrier can enter a low dock, fully dock it, and release.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulate a constrained prismatic linkage and coordinate bar centering with carrier insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Bar centered, carrier fully docked, linkage consistent, both hands released, and final state continuously stable; numeric thresholds are omitted.
comparison.reason: Tests internal captive-part centering and docking, not destructive notch fracture or recovery of free fragments.
